name: Northern Aspect
approach: Drive Cascade River Road from Marblemount (paved for roughly the first third, then gravel, narrow and steep near the end) 23.1 miles to the Cascade Pass Trailhead (road-end elevation about 3,660 ft). Hike the Cascade Pass Trail 3.7 miles / 1,700 ft gain to Cascade Pass, then continue cross-country/on climbers' path north on the Ptarmigan Traverse: ascend the Cache Glacier to Cache Col (~6,900 ft), descend to Kool-Aid Lake, cross the Middle Cascade Glacier, and continue to Yang Yang Lakes, which serves as the standard base camp below Le Conte's north side. This approach alone is a full day of glacier travel with sustained elevation gain and loss.
